description: Land Acquisition - Harankahadeniya, Pitawalagoda, Mukalanyaya and Urugamuwa East, Dickwella D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific plots of land being acquired for public purposes.
